name: Huereka
summary:
Control your light sources from Mixed Reality. Feel like a wizard when you alter the real world lights from within the headset. This amazing smart home integration works with all Philips Hue lights. 

First time you start the app, press the Hue bridge button. That's all setup needed. 

Now you can control your lights from a handy control center. 

Or you can place virtual light bulbs by your physical lights. Use them to control your lights, when you are far away or when you are close.
